content:
The **perk loadout** system is a feature in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Locked & Loaded* update.

As of the *Locked & Loaded* update, players can customize multiple S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadouts to use at separate times with their Vault Dweller during gameplay, allowing a larger variety of various perks and S.P.E.C.I.A.L. points to use in conversation with NPCs, combat, and more. Loadouts can be changed using a punch card machine.

There are five premade loadouts that can be selected at the start of the game: during the opening quest Reclamation Day, new player characters gain access to S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadouts upon walking through the exit door of Vault 76. This will trigger a popup screen to select between one of two sets of five default loadouts: "Battle Ready Dweller" or "Fresh Dweller." Fresh Dwellers are set to level 2 and merely choose a single perk card, while Battle Ready Dwellers are set to level 20, skipping early leveling to immediately prepare the character for more difficult content, and the game also positions this set as the "best choice." Battle Ready Dwellers are allowed to choose between these five premade loadouts:

Each default loadout will automatically assign SPECIAL points and perk cards to fit a given combat playstyle (while also immediately granting some relevant weapons and armor). Ammo for the loadout's preferred weapon type may also be encountered more often.

The screen also advertises an additional Level 50 Character Boost pack which can be used to immediately set the active character's level to 50 and give them new loadout options geared around that level. This is not a default option, and must be purchased in the Atomic Shop for 1500 Atoms.

The machine works as the gatekeeper to the SPECIAL loadouts system after default loadout selection during the opening quest. The machine utilizes the perk cards given to the player character during the opening quest Reclamation Day, allowing management of perks. The machine has 10 slots marked "Perk" across a board, and a yellow drop box attached on the left. Only seven of the slots, one for each SPECIAL category, is occupied. Players can interact with punch card machines throughout Appalachia or build one in one's C.A.M.P.
